about: P. Casey Mathews is a partner at Bartko Pavia LLP in San Francisco, California. An experienced litigator in both state and federal courts, he handles high-stakes commercial litigation across a wide array of fields, including intellectual property (copyright and trademark), mass torts, antitrust disputes, contract conflicts and corporate governance. He focuses on crafting cost-effective strategies to guide clients through all litigation stages, from initial pleadings to trial.

Mr. Mathews guides clients through every phase of litigation, from initial pleadings and dispositive motions to final resolution at trial. Throughout his practice, he prioritizes developing creative, tailor-made litigation strategies designed to resolve complex legal disputes efficiently. By balancing cost-effective resource management with aggressive courtroom advocacy, he ensures that each client receives a strategic approach aligned with their business goals to achieve a suitable outcome.

Upon completing his bachelor’s degree at Pomona College, Mr. Mathews went on to receive his Juris Doctor from The University of Texas at Austin School of Law. While in law school, he was part of Texas Law Review, serving as the managing editor for Volume 94. After obtaining his license to practice law in California in 2016, he began his career as an associate in Palo Alto. His background as a litigation project assistant equips him to manage essential pre- and post-litigation processes for effective trial preparation.

Further admitted to appear before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit and the U.S. District Courts for the Northern and Central Districts of California, Mr. Mathews stops at nothing to support his clients through the complex litigation processes. Approaching each case with a personalized strategy, he ensures his clients’ goals are understood and translated into his decisive, results-driven legal advocacy.
